blurb: Guests can take a guided tour at the Bend brewery to see the brewing process. Tours require a minimum of 5 people and cost $10 per person. After the tour, guests can enjoy a complimentary beer in the pub. All ages are welcome.
extraNote: 10 Barrel Eastside brewery, 62950 NE 18th St, Bend, OR 97701 · Tours available at least through Sep 6 – 12, 2026
